_comment: Allowlist for the static credential-literal scan gate (tools/harness/secret_literal_scan.py). Entries record the variable NAME, its FILE, and the RATIONALE only. Credential VALUES are NEVER stored here. A new credential-shaped literal that is not listed here fails the gate (red).

allow.name: KAKAO_JS_API_KEY
allow.reason: Public, domain-restricted Kakao Maps JavaScript client key. It is served to the browser by design (client-side SDK) and is not a secret; the Kakao console pins it to allowed referrer domains. The private REST key (KAKAO_REST_API_KEY) remains env-only (SECRET-01).

allow.name: APPROVAL_TOKEN
allow.reason: Public backfill-gate marker(비-credential). apply_safe_backfill 를 실행하려면 operator 가 이 정확한 리터럴을 넘겨야 하는 명시 승인 관문 — 값의 기밀성이 아니라 우연한 auto-run 방지가 목적. AS-BACKFILL audit-required 게이트와 동형 의도.
